title: Readouts: what is established

reviewed_findings.claim: Preliminary quality differences do not track reconstruction uniformly.
reviewed_findings.detail: Best-of-32 has 39 contradictions among 71 specific readouts, versus 46/71 for capped N1. Pooling recovers 10/24 bridge cells but only 1/21 chain cells. These are development cell diagnostics with just 2–8 independent groups per family. No general faithful-recovery gain is established.

reviewed_findings.claim: Available bridge mentions are sometimes overlooked by reconstruction selection.
reviewed_findings.detail: At N=32, 14 of 24 cells have a matched bridge somewhere in the saved pool; best reconstruction selects a match in 7. Ten cells have no matched candidate. This gold-backed ceiling diagnoses candidate availability and selection, not deployable selection or faithful relationships.

reviewed_findings.claim: A recovered name or number can appear inside a wrong explanation.
reviewed_findings.detail: The reviewed Borglum output names the matched bridge while giving the wrong relationship. A chain readout mentions the correct intermediate 5 through a computation that does not match the task. Keep mention recovery separate from process and relationship correctness.

reviewed_findings.claim: Fewer transcript contradictions can mean more unsupported details.
reviewed_findings.detail: One reviewed change removes a false span but produces nine unverifiable claims and no true claims. Another apparent regression includes plausible paraphrases that need a judge audit. Preserve the frozen verdicts and inspect factual support and judge reliability separately.

reviewed_findings.claim: The reconstructor sees only 32 tokens per bullet.
reviewed_findings.detail: The full output is judged. Suffix details have no direct reconstruction evidence. Semantic consensus also needs a repaired equivalence audit before its results can support a method claim.

endpoint_notes: FVE is reconstruction fraction of variance explained; higher fit is not proof of faithful content.
Original 16 instrument samples were preserved field-exact. All 6048 pilot samples have unique contiguous indexes 0..31; no sample hit the 256-token generation cap.
Official item-level scores require the original complete benchmark grids.
Whole related groups are resampled after aggregating cells by item.
Recovery detects mentions/bindings under the declared judge, not full explanation faithfulness.
False spans and true/unverifiable claims have different segmentation.
Random selection is one frozen draw.
No held-out or official full-grid result is reported.
Grouped intervals use only 2 independent chain groups and 4 role groups; a narrow interval cannot establish robustness.
This dashboard is local; browser verification does not make it hosted.
Additional consensus and editing comparisons remain unmeasured here. E3 conditions are measured, with trace interpretation still under review.
API amounts and development progress were observed at 2026-10-10T03:10:23.603962+00:00. Reserved includes unknown-response reservations. GPU time has no assigned dollar price.

Full deployment cost includes capture, candidate generation, phrase encoding and selection. A cached selector pass is incremental cache cost. Campaign fitting and deployment costs stay separate; no incomplete cost is presented as full inference.
